title: C++ Vector Pass-by-Reference & Range Loops
pattern_description: Best practice rules for passing C++ std::vector objects and modern range iteration.
rule: Pass vectors by const reference `const std::vector<int>&` to prevent expensive linear deep copy allocations.
recommendation: Use `const auto&` in range-based loops `for(const auto& item : vec)` when reading elements without mutating.

title: C++ Signed Integer Overflow Safety
pattern_description: Preventing undefined behavior when performing arithmetic on 32-bit signed integers.
rule: Signed integer overflow in C++ causes Undefined Behavior (UB). Use `long long` for large accumulations.
recommendation: Check bound limits before adding or multiplying large integer variables.

title: Pythonic Iteration & List Comprehensions
pattern_description: Leveraging Python built-in iterators, enumerate, and generators for cleaner execution.
rule: Avoid `for i in range(len(lst))` when element values are needed directly. Use `for item in lst:` or `for i, item in enumerate(lst):`.
recommendation: Replace simple element transformation loops with list comprehensions or generator expressions for speed and readability.

title: JavaScript Strict Equality & Const/Let Variable Scope
pattern_description: Avoiding coercion bugs and implicit globals in JS scripts.
rule: Use strict equality `===` instead of `==` to avoid automatic type coercion bugs.
recommendation: Provide a explicit compare function `(a, b) => a - b` to `Array.prototype.sort()` to prevent lexicographical sorting on numbers.

title: Java Object Equality & Collection Bounds
pattern_description: Proper usage of `.equals()` vs `==` and array indexing safety in Java.
rule: Compare Objects and Strings using `.equals()` rather than `==` which compares memory references.
recommendation: Prefer `ArrayList` or `List` interfaces over raw arrays when dynamic resizing or utility methods are needed.
